meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 7 — Informal economy & MSMEs, IKN (Nusantara) new-capital statistical traces, foreign-exchange reserves and external buffers, and further labour/financial densification.

candidates.title: Informal employment proportion statistics (by province)
candidates.description: Official Sakernas-based statistics on the share of informal employment. National figure remains high (around 58 % in recent data); provincial variation is large, with eastern and rural provinces showing much higher informality.
candidates.notes: Critical structural labour node. High informality is a defining feature of the Indonesian labour market.

candidates.title: Micro and small manufacturing industry statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on the number and characteristics of micro and small manufacturing establishments by province. Complements the large-and-medium manufacturing series and highlights the vast MSME base, especially on Java.
candidates.notes: MSME densification of the industrial cluster.

candidates.title: Broader MSME / micro-enterprise statistics and policy framing
candidates.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Cooperatives and SMEs / related
candidates.description: Official and quasi-official statistics and policy framing around micro, small and medium enterprises more broadly (beyond manufacturing). Continuously cited in employment, inclusion and recovery narratives.

candidates.title: Nusantara Capital City (IKN) population enumeration statistics
candidates.publisher: BPS / Bappenas / OIKN (Nusantara Capital City Authority)
candidates.description: Dedicated population enumeration results for the new capital city area (PPIKN). Recent figures show a still-small resident population with distinctive age and origin structure. Provides the first official statistical footprint of the IKN project.
candidates.notes: Unique project-specific demographic node. Captures the early statistical reality of the capital relocation.

candidates.title: Nusantara Capital City (IKN) legal and planning framework
candidates.description: Legal and planning instruments establishing the new capital (Undang-Undang IKN and related regulations, master plans). Recurring citation in infrastructure, fiscal and regional-development discussions.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame node for the capital-relocation project.

candidates.title: Foreign-exchange reserves statistics
candidates.description: Official international-reserve position published by Bank Indonesia. Key external-buffer indicator, routinely expressed in months of import cover and used in monetary and exchange-rate communication.

candidates.title: External debt statistics
candidates.publisher: Bank Indonesia / Ministry of Finance related
candidates.description: Statistics on external debt (public and private) that complement the BOP and reserves series. Used in sustainability and vulnerability assessments.
candidates.notes: Debt-side densification of the external cluster.

candidates.title: Labour productivity and related indicators
candidates.description: Official or derived labour-productivity measures that link employment (Sakernas) to output (national accounts). Useful for dual-structure and formal/informal analysis.
candidates.notes: Productivity bridge between labour and output clusters.

candidates.title: Financial-inclusion statistics
candidates.description: Official indicators of account ownership, access to formal financial services, and related inclusion metrics. Complements Islamic-finance and conventional banking statistics.
candidates.notes: Inclusion densification of the financial cluster.

candidates.title: Indonesia informal–MSME–IKN–external-buffer meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BPS, BI, OJK, OIKN and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding informal-employment and MSME statistics, the IKN new-capital population and legal framework, foreign-exchange reserves, external debt, labour productivity and financial-inclusion indicators into a coherent structural and project layer.
